source: Real ±1 block of length 2B, zero elsewhere, shared denominator √(2B). One H-fed balanced base coin prepares |+x>. Coherent addressed dyadic fanout starts at localized sheet and cleans the routing bit at every stage by reading the occupied address bit coherently. The source difference can be implemented by a Z sign on the most significant split; this changes no success probabilities. The apparatus can start the flight clock after source construction.
time_costs: One addressed-sheet preparation entails log2(2B) local H/signed splits and address cleanups, and 2B-1 conditional unit translations. The computed duration counts one sheet-edge translation per τ; if the H and address operations also take one such tick each, add O(τ log B). This requires synchronous address-dependent local gates and retained relative phase. It prepares the sheet, not the independent narrowing base packet.
limit: Put θ=2π/M, τ=εθ, c=μ=F=1; DFT of T^1 uses exp(-ikθ). The onsite coin H diag(T,T^-1) H gives exp(-ikθ X). A common real |+x> spinor at rest belongs to energy branch sign(k) of cp Z+kμ X for every fixed k≠0, including even k. Along p(t)=-kFt, the group velocity λ c²p/sqrt(c²p²+k²μ²) is independent of k for either sign. This is the bare X model with its own common source. Identifying it with the original D gauge and the ZH launch requires the corresponding sheet-sector constraint.
uniform_estimates: For continuum rest chart |p0|<=sqrt(eps), 1<=|k|<=K, launch band error O(sqrt(eps)/|k|), gap error O(eps/|k|), endpoint sampling O(K*tau/eps), Lie split remainder O(K²*tau/eps²) for fixed time. Rounded cumulative vector-angle counts have residual ≤|k|θ/2 and a per-tick commutator ≤2|sin(kθ)| sin(|k|θ/2) while |k|θ is small. Total dither error O(Kθ+TK²θ²/τ). Momentum support stays on small charts when Kτ/eps→0. In the scalar comparison the group velocity differs from the common ray by O(sqrt(eps)/|k|), and the smooth rest packet initially has position width O(sqrt(eps)); bounded-position characteristic convergence suffices. Combine uniform low-window errors with total high-window weight ≤M/(BK); no individual high-index limit is inferred.
adverse: An unfiltered sheet delta or a fixed-width source has no tight folded spectrum as M grows. In this integer-stride vector walk even M gives U(k+M/2)=(-1)^(1+q_n)U(k) per tick. The adjacent signed dipole has pairwise weights w_k+w_{k+M/2}=2/M exactly like the delta, so their complete sheet-unread flight statistics agree for all times under the same common base preparation and sector-independent base instruments. The antipode is a ballistic copy of k=0. The broad dipole kills both. A whole positive uniform sheet has only the massless, unforced k=0 sector. The finite fully mixed position statistics and controls do not decide their continuum behavior. The spectral mixture here is Parseval from a real coherent wavefunction; a separate incoherent path-count sector is not addressed.
